Skip to content How it works For tradies Help Log in Sign up How can we help? Search help articles Customers Posting a job How is my price worked out? When do I pay? Extra work Cancelling Something’s not right Help Customers Payments When do I pay? Updated 30 Oct 2026 · 1 min read You pay when you accept your price, before anyone turns up. That locks in your booking. Your tradie gets paid after you’ve checked the job and said it’s all good (or 48 hours after they finish, if we don’t hear from you). What if there’s extra work? You’ll see photos and the extra cost first. You only pay for it if you say yes. Was this helpful? Yes No Still stuck? We reply within one working day.
